ALTER TABLE TGQRNC ADD CODEMPNG NUMBER(10,0)
ALTER TABLE TGQRNC ADD CODCLIENTEAF NUMBER(10,0)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION FN_TGQ_PRAZO_FASE (P_RNCID NUMBER, P_FASE NUMBER, P_PADRAO NUMBER) RETURN DATE IS V_PRAZO DATE; BEGIN SELECT R.DATAREGISTRO + NVL(FO.DIAS, P_PADRAO) INTO V_PRAZO FROM TGQRNC R LEFT JOIN TGQFASESORIGEM FO ON FO.FASESNCID = P_FASE AND TO_CHAR(FO.ID) = TRIM(R.ORIGEM) WHERE R.RNCID = P_RNCID;
RETURN V_PRAZO; EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END;
